title: CMP170Hx vs Strix Halo
body: The caveat: this was a quick benchmark for concurrency, but this holds at depth even more for the CUDA card vs AMD. In addition, MTP is on for strix halo, and off for the CMP170. I could not go further comparing because the Strix instance crashes at higher concurrency. FOR PEOPLE WHO RUN LOCAL LLAMAS. I run models locally, which is the purpose of this sub.
